name: Ria
source:
Main heroine of the story. Ria is the mysterious fighter who observes Sect Queencroiz.

[spoiler]She was the former member of Queencroiz, Queens best friernd and oldest of the Four Heavenly kings. But left the sect after her twin-sisters death cause she can't bare the new Queens politic and behavior.[/spoiler]
